title: 我的一天

lines.chinese: 我每天早上七点起床。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
lines.english: I wake up at 7 o'clock every morning.

lines.chinese: 我先喝一杯水，然后吃早饭。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiān hē yī bēi shuǐ, ránhòu chī zǎofàn.
lines.english: I first drink a glass of water, then eat breakfast.

lines.chinese: 早饭是面包和鸡蛋。
lines.pinyin: Zǎofàn shì miànbāo hé jīdàn.
lines.english: Breakfast is bread and eggs.

lines.chinese: 八点，我去学校。
lines.pinyin: Bā diǎn, wǒ qù xuéxiào.
lines.english: At 8 o'clock, I go to school.

lines.chinese: 学校很近，我走路去。
lines.pinyin: Xuéxiào hěn jìn, wǒ zǒulù qù.
lines.english: The school is very close, I walk there.

lines.chinese: 我很喜欢我的老师。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān wǒ de lǎoshī.
lines.english: I really like my teacher.

lines.chinese: 下午，我在家学习汉语。
lines.pinyin: Xiàwǔ, wǒ zài jiā xuéxí Hànyǔ.
lines.english: In the afternoon, I study Chinese at home.

vocabulary.meaning: to wake up / get out of bed

comprehension_question: What does the person eat for breakfast? (Reply: answer: [your answer])
comprehension_answer: bread and eggs / 面包和鸡蛋

title: 小猫和老鼠

lines.chinese: 有一只小猫，它很可爱。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yī zhī xiǎo māo, tā hěn kě'ài.
lines.english: There is a little cat, it is very cute.

lines.chinese: 小猫每天都想抓老鼠。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎo māo měitiān dōu xiǎng zhuā lǎoshǔ.
lines.english: The cat wants to catch mice every day.

lines.chinese: 有一天，老鼠跑得很快。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yī tiān, lǎoshǔ pǎo de hěn kuài.
lines.english: One day, the mouse ran very fast.

lines.chinese: 小猫追不上它。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎo māo zhuī bù shàng tā.
lines.english: The cat couldn't catch up with it.

lines.chinese: 老鼠笑着说：'你跑得太慢了！'
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshǔ xiào zhe shuō: 'Nǐ pǎo de tài màn le!'
lines.english: The mouse laughed and said: 'You run too slowly!'

lines.chinese: 小猫很不高兴，决定每天练习跑步。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎo māo hěn bù gāoxìng, juédìng měitiān liànxí pǎobù.
lines.english: The cat was unhappy and decided to practice running every day.

lines.chinese: 努力是成功的开始！
lines.pinyin: Nǔlì shì chénggōng de kāishǐ!
lines.english: Hard work is the beginning of success!

comprehension_question: Why was the cat unhappy? (Reply: answer: [your answer])
comprehension_answer: because it couldn't catch the mouse / the mouse said it was too slow

title: 去超市买东西

lines.chinese: 今天妈妈让我去超市买东西。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān māma ràng wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi dōngxi.
lines.english: Today mom asked me to go to the supermarket to buy things.

lines.chinese: 我需要买苹果、牛奶和面条。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào mǎi píngguǒ, niúnǎi hé miàntiáo.
lines.english: I need to buy apples, milk, and noodles.

lines.chinese: 超市里的人很多，很热闹。
lines.pinyin: Chāoshì lǐ de rén hěn duō, hěn rènào.
lines.english: There are many people in the supermarket, very lively.

lines.chinese: 苹果一斤五块钱，我买了两斤。
lines.pinyin: Píngguǒ yī jīn wǔ kuài qián, wǒ mǎi le liǎng jīn.
lines.english: Apples are 5 yuan per jin, I bought two jin.

lines.chinese: 找到牛奶和面条之后，我去付钱。
lines.pinyin: Zhǎodào niúnǎi hé miàntiáo zhīhòu, wǒ qù fù qián.
lines.english: After finding the milk and noodles, I went to pay.

lines.chinese: 一共花了二十块钱。
lines.pinyin: Yīgòng huā le èrshí kuài qián.
lines.english: It cost 20 yuan in total.

lines.chinese: 妈妈看到我买的东西，很高兴。
lines.pinyin: Māma kàndào wǒ mǎi de dōngxi, hěn gāoxìng.
lines.english: Mom saw what I bought and was very happy.

comprehension_question: How much did the apples cost per jin, and how many jin did they buy? (Reply: answer: [your answer])

title: 我的朋友来自蒙古
title_pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu lái zì Měnggǔ

lines.chinese: 我有一个好朋友，她叫苏菲亚。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī gè hǎo péngyǒu, tā jiào Sūfēiyà.
lines.english: I have a good friend, her name is Sofia.

lines.chinese: 她来自蒙古，现在在中国学习。
lines.pinyin: Tā lái zì Měnggǔ, xiànzài zài Zhōngguó xuéxí.
lines.english: She comes from Mongolia and is now studying in China.

lines.chinese: 她的汉语说得越来越好。
lines.pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ shuō de yuè lái yuè hǎo.
lines.english: Her Chinese is getting better and better.

lines.chinese: 她每天学习一个小时汉语。
lines.pinyin: Tā měitiān xuéxí yī gè xiǎoshí Hànyǔ.
lines.english: She studies Chinese for one hour every day.

lines.chinese: 她告诉我，蒙古的冬天非常冷。
lines.pinyin: Tā gàosu wǒ, Měnggǔ de dōngtiān fēicháng lěng.
lines.english: She told me that winters in Mongolia are extremely cold.

lines.chinese: 她的梦想是去复旦大学读研究生。
lines.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì qù Fùdàn Dàxué dú yánjiūshēng.
lines.english: Her dream is to study for a master's degree at Fudan University.

lines.chinese: 我相信她一定会成功的！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn tā yīdìng huì chénggōng de!
lines.english: I believe she will definitely succeed!

comprehension_question: What is Sofia's dream? (Reply: answer: [your answer])
comprehension_answer: to study for a master's degree at Fudan University

title: 第一次喝奶茶
title_english: Drinking Bubble Tea for the First Time

lines.chinese: 我的朋友带我去喝奶茶。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu dài wǒ qù hē nǎichá.
lines.english: My friend took me to drink bubble tea.

lines.chinese: 这是我第一次喝奶茶。
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì hē nǎichá.
lines.english: This was my first time drinking bubble tea.

lines.chinese: 菜单上有很多口味：草莓、抹茶、芒果……
lines.pinyin: Càidān shàng yǒu hěn duō kǒuwèi: cǎoméi, mǒchá, mángguǒ……
lines.english: The menu had many flavors: strawberry, matcha, mango...

lines.chinese: 我选了芒果味，加了珍珠。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xuǎn le mángguǒ wèi, jiā le zhēnzhū.
lines.english: I chose mango flavor and added tapioca pearls.

lines.chinese: 第一口，甜甜的，非常好喝！
lines.pinyin: Dì yī kǒu, tián tián de, fēicháng hǎo hē!
lines.english: The first sip — sweet and delicious!

lines.chinese: 珍珠嚼起来很有趣，软软的。
lines.pinyin: Zhēnzhū jiáo qǐlái hěn yǒuqù, ruǎn ruǎn de.
lines.english: Chewing the pearls was fun — soft and chewy.

lines.chinese: 我爱上了奶茶，以后要常常来！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ ài shàng le nǎichá, yǐhòu yào chángcháng lái!
lines.english: I fell in love with bubble tea and will come often!

vocabulary.meaning: pearl / tapioca balls in bubble tea
to fall in love with something

comprehension_question: What flavor did the person choose, and what did they add? (Reply: answer: [your answer])
